summary: scripts/ci-local-test's kill_tree, the cleanup that kills a failing test's run and every process under it, now holds each process by a pidfd from the moment it finds it and returns only once every one has exited. The frozen-lane test asserts right after it instead of polling for 2 s, which failed twice in merge groups when the killed lane took longer than that to exit on a loaded runner

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

compatibility.detail: Only the self-test changes: scripts/ci-local and every stage it runs are unchanged.
